entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to start a return for an order I received last week.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-21. It's for the new cycling shoes I bought.

Got it, I've pulled up your order. I see the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes, delivered on January 16th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a fit issue. I mounted my cleats and went for a ride, but they just aren't right for my feet. I'm already getting blisters on my heels, which is a bad sign.

I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Comfort is key. Since you received them just 7 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window for apparel and shoes.
Great, so a full refund is possible?

Absolutely. I can process this as a standard return for a full refund to your original payment method. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you now. I'll email it to the address on file. Is that the best place to send it?

Yes, that works. Thanks for making that easy. Now, since I did have to go through the trouble of installing the cleats, testing them out, and now I have to repackage everything... would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next VeloFit order? Maybe 10% off for the inconvenience?

I understand the request, and I appreciate you asking. While I can't provide a discount code for a return of this nature, I can assure you that you will receive a 100% refund for the cycling shoes once we receive them at our warehouse. Our return policy is designed to make sure you're not stuck with gear that doesn't work for you.
Okay, I see. No problem, I figured it was worth a shot. The full refund is the most important thing. You can go ahead and send that label.
Perfect. The email with the label is on its way to you now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any postal service location. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
